children.game_version: A 'follow the leader' circle game where children mimic the 'floating' steps.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the arm-based circular strokes while seated, focusing on fluid motion.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the lateral steps with support, reducing the range of motion.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo to ensure comfort and stability.

movement_profile.footwork: small lateral steps, floating steps (syzme), and small forward/side movements (khyrdalyk)

signature_moves.description: Small movements forward or from side to side.
signature_moves.name: Khyrdalyk

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: variation of two-, three-, and four-bar motives
music_profile.sound_description: A lyrical melody developed through the variation of two-, three-, and four-bar motives, designed to accompany smooth, floating dance steps.

basic_steps: Circular strokes of the arms and body
Khyrdalyk: small lateral or forward movements
